system.longDesc: You are adept with weapons you throw by hand.

degree0.desc: Your accuracy is uncanny. You gain a +1 bonus on attack rolls with weapons from the Thrown Weapons and Grenades group.

degree1.desc: You can grab a throwing weapon in an instant. You Ready a throwing weapon or grenade as a free action instead of a minor action.

degree2.desc: You master your own leverage to throw further. You can add your Accuracy to the range of throwing weapons and grenades.
